prompt: Why does the organizer tell participants to use the bench?
promptZh: 主辦人為什麼請參加者把自己的袋子放到長椅？

options.text: So the partner shop can collect those bags first.
options.zh: 好讓合作店家先收那些袋子。
options.whyZh: 店家收的是長桌剩下的衣物，不收自備袋。

options.text: So that the garment racks can be moved after the swap.
options.whyZh: 講者沒有提要移架，主要是不要把袋子誤認成交換品。

options.text: So personal bags are not picked up as items for the swap.
options.zh: 避免個人袋被誤認為交換物而被拿走。
options.whyZh: 袋子不放在展示區下方，就不容易被當成交換物。

options.text: So participants can still exchange clothes after closing.
options.zh: 好讓參加者關門後仍能交換衣物。
options.whyZh: 晚到可以放衣物，不表示打烊後還能交換；長椅用來區別個人袋。

explanationZh: 袋子不放在展示區下方，就不容易被當成交換物。
evidence: Just don’t leave your own bag under either display; take it to the bench so people won’t mistake it for part of the swap.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Just don’t leave your own bag under either display; take it to the bench so people won’t mistake it for part of the swap.

vocabulary.note: 第二個物件是被錯認的身分；這裡是誤認私人包包可供交換。
